snippet.title: Boil Cabbage Make Soup - Out Now!
snippet.description:
Boil Cabbage Make Soup is now available on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4585070/Boil_Cabbage_Make_Soup/

Boil Cabbage Make Soup is an idle, playable sticker you can place anywhere on your desktop. You play as a busy onion living on a floating island, who grows cabbages, makes delicious soup, and earns gold from eager customers!

With your gold, you can purchase Lucky Tickets to exchange for clothing for your onion and decorations for your island. Or, use your gold to level up your soup-making skills and increase your onion’s soupy production. Let the onion do all the hard work whilst you focus on your tasks and enjoy a selection of cosy, chill and lively music from the 9th Dawn OST.
